principles: Use only public or explicitly approved datasets.
Do not commit raw clinical datasets to git.
Do not claim clinical performance before evaluation against documented labels.
Keep each modality separate until the fusion strategy is explicitly justified.

datasets.name: CTU-UHB Intrapartum Cardiotocography Database
notes: Use as the first supervised baseline because FHR and uterine contraction channels are already aligned as CTG time series.
Outcome metadata must be parsed from records and documented before any supervised label is enabled.
This is CTG reference data, not a direct replacement for FETAL-GUARD piezo/FSR/MAX30102 hardware data.

datasets.name: Fetal PCG Database
notes: Use for fetal heart sound preprocessing experiments only after documenting sampling rate and labels from downloaded records.
Do not mix with CTG labels unless an explicit cross-modality experiment is defined.

datasets.name: Abdominal and Direct Fetal ECG Database
notes: Use as a reference for fetal cardiac signal extraction concepts.
This modality differs from piezo/PCG and must not be treated as equivalent without validation.
